scripts.name: Game summary
scripts.code:
# Game summary: who you are, the turn, the forces, your rooms and the map.
# Read-only; works for the admin and White Force roles.
import wrx

game = wrx.Game()
me = await game.context()
setup = await game.setup()
turn = await game.turn()

print("Game:", setup.name)
print("Running as:", "admin" if me.isAdmin else me.roleId)
print("Turn:", f"{turn.turn}, {turn.phase}" if turn else "not started")

print("\nForces:")
for force in await game.forces():
    print(" -", force.name)

print("\nMy rooms:")
for room in await game.rooms():
    print(" -", room.name)

state = await game.world_state()
print("\nAssets on the map:", len(state.assets) if state else 0)

scripts.name: Asset report (pandas)
scripts.code:
# Asset report: health and fuel by force, plus the assets that need attention.
# Read-only. Uses pandas, which loads the first time (a few seconds).
import wrx

game = wrx.Game()
state = await game.world_state()
if state is None:
    raise SystemExit("No world state has been published yet.")

forces = {f.id: f.name for f in await game.forces()}
frame = wrx.to_frame(state)
frame["force"] = frame["forceId"].map(forces)

print(f"Turn {state.turn}: {len(frame)} assets\n")
summary = frame.groupby("force")[["health", "fuel"]].agg(["count", "mean", "min"]).round(1)
print(summary.to_string())

weak = frame[(frame["health"] < 50) | (frame["fuel"] < 25)]
print("\nNeeds attention (health < 50 or fuel < 25):")
print(weak[["force", "title", "state", "health", "fuel"]].to_string(index=False) if len(weak) else " none")

scripts.name: Recent messages
scripts.code:
# Recent messages: the last five messages in each of your rooms, newest first.
# Read-only; works for the admin and White Force roles.
import wrx

game = wrx.Game()
for room in await game.rooms():
    print(f"== {room.name} ==")
    count = 0
    async for message in game.room(room).messages(order="newest-first", limit=5):
        count += 1
        who = "admin" if message.sender.isAdmin else (message.sender.loginName or "?")
        body = message.body
        if body.type == "chat":
            text = body.content.text
        elif body.type == "template":
            text = f"[template card {body.content.templateId}]"
        else:
            text = f"[world state, turn {body.content.turn}]"
        print(f"{message.sentAt:%d %b %H:%M}  {who}: {text[:80]}")
    if count == 0:
        print(" (no messages)")
    print()

scripts.name: Advance Blue (admin)
scripts.code:
# Advance Blue (admin only): move each Blue asset about 1 km north-east and burn
# 15% fuel, then put the result in the world-state draft. Nothing is published:
# open the Map room to see the moved symbols, then "Publish world state..." shows
# the change summary first. Run "resupply.py" afterwards to top the fuel back up.
import wrx
import wrx_draft

game = wrx.Game()
if not (await game.context()).isAdmin:
    raise SystemExit("Only the admin can write the world-state draft.")

state = await game.world_state()
if state is None:
    raise SystemExit("No world state has been published yet.")

blue = next((f for f in await game.forces() if f.name == "Blue"), None)
if blue is None:
    raise SystemExit("No force called Blue in this game.")

moved = 0
for asset_id, asset in list(state.assets.items()):
    if asset.forceId != blue.id:
        continue
    state.assets[asset_id] = asset.model_copy(
        update={
            "lat": round(asset.lat + 0.006, 6),
            "lon": round(asset.lon + 0.009, 6),
            "fuel": max(0, asset.fuel - 15),
        }
    )
    moved += 1
    print(f"Moved {asset.title}; fuel {asset.fuel:.0f}% -> {max(0, asset.fuel - 15):.0f}%")

await wrx_draft.write_draft(state)
print(f"\n{moved} Blue assets moved in the draft. Open the Map room to review.")
